summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The report includes revenue of S$3.77 million (US$2.93 million), a 38% year-on-year increase, and an adjusted EBITDA deficit narrowing to S$1.02 million (US$0.79 million), a 44% improvement. Shareholders' equity stood at S$31.12 million (US$24.14 million). The press release highlights operational efficiency gains and capital-raising activities completed in 2025. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation event. No transaction, corporate action, or event triggering special-situations classification is present.
